input: Buy a quality chef's knife before the holidays

gold.taskTitle: Buy a quality chef's knife before the holidays
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase a high-quality chef's knife in time for the upcoming holiday season.

questions.title: Which holiday are you buying this knife before?
questions.description: Identify the specific holiday deadline so a timeline can be set.

questions.title: What is your budget for this purchase?
questions.description: Determine the price range the user is comfortable spending on a chef's knife.

questions.title: Is this knife for yourself or as a gift?
questions.description: Clarify whether the knife is a personal purchase or intended for someone else.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific blade material or brand?
questions.description: Find out if the user has preferences such as German steel, Japanese stainless, or a particular brand like Wusthof or Shun.

questions.title: What blade length are you looking for?
questions.description: Determine the preferred knife size, such as 6-inch, 8-inch, or 10-inch.

questions.title: Will you buy in a physical store or shop online?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred shopping method to tailor research and purchasing steps accordingly.

questions.title: How much cooking experience does the user or recipient have?
questions.description: Understand the skill level to recommend a knife that matches the user's or recipient's needs, from beginner to professional.
